color.note: Neutral chrome, color reserved for the drawing and for status. Dark is the primary theme; every value is set for light too.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Drawing canvas background only. Never used for chrome.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Application frame: title bar, toolbars, status bar, window background behind docks.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Docked panels: inspector, layers, area table, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Inset controls on panels: text and number fields, table rows, selected tab.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed states of quiet controls; menu item hover; secondary button fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between panels, table rules, section separators. Never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of text/number fields and secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on canvas and surface-0 to surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: field labels, column headers, units, inactive tabs. On surface-0 to surface-3.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled text, keyboard shortcut hints. On surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2 only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one chrome accent: primary button fill, active tool, selection, focus ring, checked states. Never decoration.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (dark theme uses dark ink because the accent is light).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text and links on surface-0 to surface-3.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected row or list item background, under ink text.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid keyboard focus outline, offset 1px. Over 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Valid/closed states: polygon closed, sketch saved, check passed. Teal, not green, so it never relies on red/green hue alone. Text on surface-0 to surface-2.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: open polygon, overlapping areas, unsaved changes. Text on surface-0 to surface-2.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: invalid dimension, delete. Text on surface-0 to surface-2; always paired with an icon or word.

tokens.name: draw-wall
tokens.usage: Exterior wall and area perimeter strokes on canvas.

tokens.name: draw-wall-interior
tokens.usage: Interior walls, openings and fixtures on canvas.

tokens.name: draw-dimension
tokens.usage: Dimension lines, extension lines, tick marks and dimension text on canvas.

tokens.name: draw-guide
tokens.usage: Temporary construction guides and alignment lines while drawing. Dashed.

tokens.name: draw-snap
tokens.usage: Snap point markers (endpoint, midpoint, intersection). Always a shape glyph, never color alone.

tokens.name: draw-selection
tokens.usage: Selected entities on canvas: stroke plus grip handles.

tokens.name: grid-major
tokens.usage: Major grid lines on canvas (every 10 ft or 5 m).

tokens.name: grid-minor
tokens.usage: Minor grid lines on canvas (every 1 ft or 0.5 m).

tokens.name: area-gla
tokens.usage: Fill for above-grade finished living area (GLA) on canvas and its legend chip.

tokens.name: area-basement
tokens.usage: Fill for below-grade area (finished or unfinished basement).

tokens.name: area-garage
tokens.usage: Fill for garage and carport areas.

tokens.name: area-porch
tokens.usage: Fill for porches, decks, patios and balconies.

tokens.name: area-other
tokens.usage: Fill for other non-GLA areas (unfinished attic, storage, outbuildings).

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Dialog and welcome-screen titles. One per view.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel titles and modal section headers.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: menus, buttons, field values, table cells.
styles.sample: Close the polygon to compute area

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text; table totals; inspector section headers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, tab labels, column headers.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, status bar text, tooltips, shortcut hints.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Every number in a field or table: areas, lengths, counts. Right-aligned in tables.

styles.name: dimension
styles.usage: Dimension text on canvas (scales with zoom from this base).

styles.name: coordinate
styles.usage: Cursor coordinates and scale readouts in the status bar.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Desktop density: most gaps are 4 or 8.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; gap between toolbar buttons; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; gap between fields in a row; inspector row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding; gap between inspector sections' content and edges.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; gap between groups of fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog section spacing; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Welcome screen and large layout margins.

radius.note: Every visible edge is rounded: no square corners on any control, container or mark. Inner radius = outer radius minus the padding between them.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small marks: checkboxes, legend chips, tooltips, grip handles, the dimension text knockout, tab underline.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, tool buttons, fields, tabs, menu items, status bar.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Containers: toolbars (docked and floating), inspector sections, tables, panels, popovers, dialogs.

shadow.note: Docked chrome is flat and separated by borders. Shadows only on things that float over the canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating toolbars and the heads-up input box over the canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, dialogs.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Compact buttons and fields inside the inspector and tables.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, field and tab height.

tokens.name: tool-button
tokens.usage: Square tool button in the main toolbar.

tokens.name: toolbar
tokens.usage: Main toolbar height (horizontal) or width (vertical).

tokens.name: status-bar
tokens.usage: Status bar height.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Standard icon box; 1.5px stroke, round caps and joins.

stroke.note: Screen line weights on canvas at 100% zoom; print weights are set per output.

tokens.name: stroke-hairline
tokens.usage: Grid, dimension and extension lines, interior walls.

tokens.name: stroke-wall
tokens.usage: Exterior walls and area perimeters.

tokens.name: stroke-selection
tokens.usage: Selected entity stroke and focus ring width.
